headline: Palantir's NHS England contract to run until 2029 before ending
summary: UK ministers decided Palantir's NHS England data contract will continue until 2029, to give time to line up British replacement suppliers, despite calls from some Labour MPs to end the arrangement sooner. Critics said the extension gives the US supplier more time to entrench itself, while the government framed the move as ending, rather than renewing, the contract.

claims.statement: Ministers decided Palantir's NHS England contract will not end until 2029, to allow time to line up British replacements.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet frames the decision as Palantir winning a further two-year extension, while another frames it as ministers formally ending the contract, albeit only from 2029.
